titleEn: The Complete Whole-House Renovation Process in Vancouver (2026): Step-by-Step From Decision to Keys
titleZh: 温哥华全面装修完整流程（2026年版）：从决定到拿钥匙的步骤指南
contentEn:
Planning a whole-house renovation in Vancouver in 2026 means navigating real costs, BC Building Code timelines, and contractor availability that most articles skip. This guide gives you the sequential process with actual dollar figures so you know exactly where your money goes.

Step 1: Assessment ($800-$1,500)

Before signing any contract, hire a renovation consultant to assess what work is truly required. This covers structural integrity, electrical panel capacity, plumbing pipe material (Poly-B, galvanized, or copper), insulation levels, and HVAC adequacy. Reno Stars includes this assessment at no extra charge. If your home has Poly-B plumbing (1975-1995 homes), budget $15,000-$35,000 for re-piping. Knob-and-tube wiring in pre-1960 homes requires full replacement at $15,000-$40,000 before walls open.

Step 2: Define Your Renovation Tier

Four cost tiers in Vancouver:

  • Cosmetic Refresh: $49,000-$80,000. Flooring, trim, painting, fixture updates. 4-6 months.
  • Mid-Range: $80,000-$150,000. One kitchen gut, two bathroom gut-rehabs, partial rewire. 6-9 months.
  • Substantial: $150,000-$250,000. Full kitchen and all bathrooms gutted, new HVAC, full re-plumb and rewire. 9-15 months.
  • Structural Transformation: $250,000-$350,000+. Second-storey addition, foundation work, engineering. 15-30 months.

The 2025 median whole-house renovation cost in Greater Vancouver was $92,900 (RenovationFind, 2025).

Step 3: Design and Permits (2-4 Months)

Architects in Vancouver charge $75-$175 per hour; flat-fee design runs $8,000-$25,000. Reno Stars provides in-house design. Vancouver renovation permits take 4-8 weeks for routine work; structural changes take 12-20 weeks. BC Building Code Section 3.7 requires an energy efficiency report for renovations exceeding 75% of wall/floor/ceiling surfaces -- adding $2,000-$5,000 and 2-4 weeks.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars -- our team walks you through realistic budgets before you commit.

Step 4: Hiring Your Contractor

Vancouver contracts must include: Consumer Protection BC license number, itemized scope and price, start/completion dates, 10% holdback clause (legally required), and WSBC clearance letter. Red flags: deposit over 10%, refusal to provide a written contract, no WSBC account. Reno Stars holds full WSBC coverage and provides license docs upfront. Always request fixed-price for whole-house projects.

Step 5: Construction Sequence

  • Weeks 1-2: Demo and asbestos abatement ($8,000-$40,000 if present).
  • Weeks 3-4: Structural repairs and engineering inspections.
  • Weeks 5-8: Mechanical rough-ins -- electrical, plumbing, HVAC. Poly-B and knob-and-tube issues typically surface here.
  • Weeks 9-12: Insulation and drywall. Code requires R-22 minimum for attics, R-12 for exterior walls in Vancouver Climate Zone 4.
  • Weeks 13-16: Finishes -- tiling, flooring, cabinetry, painting, fixtures.
  • Weeks 17-20: Final trim, HVAC commissioning, city final inspection.

2-4 week timeline adjustments are normal for October-March rain delays and 2026 supply chain unpredictability.

Step 6: Budget Contingency

Pre-1970 homes: 15% contingency. Post-1990 homes: 10%. 1975-1990 with Poly-B: 20%. Common surprises: rotted subfloor after flooring removal, moisture damage behind shower walls, undersized electrical panels, HVAC at end-of-life discovered mid-project. See how Reno Stars manages these for real clients: custom whole-house project in Vancouver and home office conversion project.

Step 7: Final Walkthrough and Warranty

BC requires a 5-day cooling-off period after signing. 10% holdback retained for 6 months after completion. Conduct a written punch-list with your contractor. Reno Stars provides a digital punch-list form with photographs. Our renovation warranty covers labour for 24 months and all materials for the manufacturer warranty period.

Whole-House Renovation FAQs

How long does a whole-house renovation take in Vancouver in 2026?

Cosmetic refresh: 4-6 months. Mid-range: 6-9 months. Substantial with layout changes: 9-15 months. Structural with additions: 15-30 months.

What does a kitchen cost as part of a whole-house renovation?

The kitchen consumes 30-40% of a mid-range whole-house budget. A complete kitchen gut-rehab with new cabinetry, quartz countertops, quality appliances, and proper lighting runs $45,000-$75,000 in Vancouver. Each additional full bathroom gut-rehab adds $15,000-$27,000.

Do I need a building permit for a whole-house renovation in Vancouver?

Yes. Any renovation altering structure, changing room use, adding/removing walls, or modifying plumbing/electrical requires a permit. Cosmetic work like painting and flooring replacement typically does not. BC Building Code requires structural permits for wall removal or header installation.

How do I budget for Poly-B pipes in a renovation?

Poly-B was installed in approximately 60% of Vancouver-area homes built 1975-1995. Re-piping costs $15,000-$35,000 depending on fixture count and accessibility. Reno Stars includes a plumbing assessment in our initial consultation.

计划在温哥华进行2026年全面房屋装修，意味着要应对真实成本、建筑法规时间线和承包商排期问题。本指南提供完整顺序流程和实际美元数字。

步骤一：评估费用（$800-$1,500）

签署合同前，聘请装修顾问评估真正需要的工程范围。涵盖结构完整性、电表容量、管道材质、隔热水平和HVAC系统。聚星装修此评估不额外收费。若房屋使用Poly-B管道（1975-1995年建造），管道重铺预算$15,000-$35,000。1960年前房屋的明线布线重铺需$15,000-$40,000。

步骤二：确定装修等级

温哥华四个成本等级：

  • Cosmetic Refresh：$49,000-$80,000。地板、装饰条、粉刷，固定装置更新。4-6个月。
  • Mid-Range：$80,000-$150,000。一间厨房全拆，两间浴室全拆翻新，部分重布线。6-9个月。
  • Substantial：$150,000-$250,000。厨房及所有浴室全拆，新HVAC，全屋管道和重布线。9-15个月。
  • Structural Transformation：$250,000-$350,000+。二楼加建，基础工程，需要工程师。15-30个月。

2025年大温哥华地区全屋装修中位成本为$92,900（RenovationFind, 2025）。

步骤三：设计与许可（2-4个月）

温哥华建筑师收费$75-$175/小时，固定设计费$8,000-$25,000。聚星装修提供内部设计。常规装修许可需4-8周；结构更改需12-20周。BC建筑法规第3.7节要求对超过75%墙面/地板/天花板面积的装修提交能源效率报告——增加$2,000-$5,000和2-4周。

正在计划厨房、浴室、全屋或商业装修？联系聚星装修获取免费、无义务报价——我们团队在您承诺前详细分析真实预算。

步骤四：聘请承包商

温哥华合同必须包含：消费者保护BC许可证号码、分项范围和价格、开工/完工日期、10%保留条款（法律要求）、WSBC清关函。危险信号：定金超过10%、拒绝书面合同、无WSBC账户。聚星装修持有完整WSBC保险并提前提供许可证文件。全屋项目务必要求固定价格合同。

步骤五：施工顺序

  • 第1-2周：拆除和石棉处理（如存在，$8,000-$40,000）。
  • 第3-4周：结构修复和工程检查。
  • 第5-8周：电气、管道、HVAC粗装。Poly-B和明线问题通常在此阶段出现。
  • 第9-12周：隔热和干墙。温哥华气候带4建筑法规要求阁楼R-22，外墙R-12。
  • 第13-16周：瓷砖、地板、橱柜、粉刷，固定装置等饰面工程。
  • 第17-20周：最终收尾、HVAC调试、城市最终检查。

10月至3月雨季和2026年供应链不可预测，时间线调整2-4周属正常。

步骤六：预算应急资金

1970年前房屋：15%应急资金。1990年后房屋：10%。1975-1990年且有Poly-B管道：20%。常见意外：地板拆除后腐烂底层地板、淋浴墙后潮湿损坏、尺寸不足的电气面板，项目中期发现HVAC到使用寿命。了解聚星装修如何为真实客户处理这些问题：温哥华定制全屋装修项目和家庭办公室装修项目。

步骤七：最终检查和保修

BC省要求签署装修合同后有5天冷静期。完工后6个月内保留10%保留金。与承包商进行书面整改清单检查。聚星装修提供双方签署的数字化整改清单表格和照片。装修保修涵盖24个月人工和制造商保修期内的所有材料。

全屋装修常见问题

2026年温哥华全屋装修需要多长时间？

Cosmetic 更新：4-6个月。中档：6-9个月。布局更改的较大工程：9-15个月。有加建的結構工程：15-30个月。

全屋装修中厨房成本是多少？

厨房通常占中档全屋预算的30-40%。温哥华全套厨房全拆翻新（新橱柜、石英石台面、优质电器、适当照明）运行$45,000-$75,000。每增加一间全浴室全拆翻新，增加$15,000-$27,000。

温哥华全屋装修需要建筑许可吗？

是的。任何改变结构、房间用途、增减墙壁或修改管道/电气系统的装修都需要许可。粉刷和更换地板等装饰工程通常不需要许可。BC建筑法规要求对拆除墙壁或安装过梁的工程持有结构许可。

有Poly-B管道如何预算全屋装修？

Poly-B管道安装于约60%的1975-1995年温哥华地区房屋。管道重铺费用为$15,000-$35,000，取决于固定装置数量和可及性。聚星装修将管道评估纳入初步咨询服务。
